sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include imipenem and cilastatin as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 66 vials of the 500 mg + 500 mg injection with a daily use of 16.5 vials, giving 4 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 105 vials with a daily use of 3.5 vials, giving 29.8 days on hand.
The highest-ranked rule option is to transfer 55 vials of 500 mg + 500 mg from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, which would leave Lakeside with 14 days and bring East to 7 days.
A third option is to buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on the FDA shortage list today.
